links.comparator_used: AI-only model that outputs every facial feature prediction with no human replacement of low-confidence outputs
links.outcome: Autism classification performance (sensitivity, AUROC) on home videos
links.effect: Aggregate out-of-fold AUROC 0.76 for the HITL-enhanced multimodal model vs 0.54 for AI-only. Mean sensitivity rose from 0.51 (SD 0.24) at a confidence threshold of 0.1 to 0.66 (SD 0.10) at 0.9, about 15 percentage points.
links.tradeoff: Human annotation workload rose with the threshold: at 0.9, 59.7% (597/1000) of frames were replaced by crowd-worker annotations. Performance was nonmonotonic at intermediate thresholds. The study is exploratory, on 100 videos, and does not isolate the causal effect of human replacement.
links.quote: The HITL-enhanced multimodal model achieved an aggregate out-of-fold AUROC of 0.76, compared with 0.54 for the AI-only model.
